types.name: Amm
docs: Virtual AMM. Reserves are *virtual* (no tokens held) and in `AMM_RESERVE_PRECISION`.
Mark price = quote_asset_reserve * peg_multiplier / base_asset_reserve (PRICE_PRECISION).

fields.name: base_asset_amount_long
docs: Net base held by longs / shorts via the AMM (for skew + funding).

fields.name: cumulative_funding_rate_long
docs: Cumulative funding (per base unit) paid by longs / shorts.

fields.name: last_mark_price_twap
docs: TWAP accumulators (PRICE_PRECISION).

fields.name: total_fee
docs: Lifetime fees collected by the AMM (QUOTE_PRECISION).

fields.name: base_amount
docs: Base magnitude to close (BASE_PRECISION). 0 = full close.

fields.name: price_limit
docs: Slippage guard (PRICE_PRECISION): min avg price when closing a long (selling),
max avg price when closing a short (buying). 0 = none.

fields.name: peg_multiplier
docs: Initial price in PEG_PRECISION (mark price at creation).

fields.name: amm_reserve
docs: Per-side virtual reserve depth (also sqrt_k): larger => less slippage.

fields.name: price
docs: Initial price in PRICE_PRECISION (1e6).

fields.name: conf
docs: Initial confidence in PRICE_PRECISION (1e6).

fields.name: total_shares
docs: Total shares outstanding (for future LP staking; admin-seeded on devnet).

fields.name: total_deposits
docs: Total quote deposited, QUOTE_PRECISION.

fields.name: oracle
docs: Price account: a Pyth `PriceUpdateV2` (Pyth source) or a `MockOracle` (Mock source).

fields.name: oracle_source
docs: How to interpret `oracle`. Defaults to Pyth.

fields.name: feed_id
docs: Expected Pyth feed id — verified against the price-update account on read (Pyth source).

fields.name: margin_ratio_initial
docs: Initial / maintenance margin ratios, in `MARGIN_PRECISION` (1e4).

fields.name: max_leverage
docs: Convenience cap (margin ratios are the real constraint).

fields.name: min_order_base
docs: Minimum order size in base (BASE_PRECISION).

fields.name: name
docs: Display name, e.g. "SOL-PERP" (null-padded).

fields.name: authority
docs: The only key allowed to push new prices.

fields.name: price
docs: Price in `PRICE_PRECISION` (1e6).

fields.name: conf
docs: Confidence in `PRICE_PRECISION` (1e6).

fields.name: last_update_ts
docs: Wall-clock of the last push — used for the same staleness guard as Pyth.

fields.name: base_amount
docs: Order size, magnitude in BASE_PRECISION.

fields.name: price_limit
docs: Slippage guard (PRICE_PRECISION): max avg price for a long, min for a short. 0 = none.

types.name: OracleSource
docs: Where a market sources its index price.

types.name: PerpPosition
docs: A position in a single market. `base_asset_amount` is signed: positive = long,
negative = short. `quote_entry_amount` is the signed cost basis (negative when you
paid quote to go long, positive when you received quote to go short) so that
`uPnL = base_value + quote_entry_amount` — see `crate::math::pnl`.

fields.name: order_type
docs: `Limit` (resting maker), `TriggerMarket` / `TriggerLimit` (stop-loss / take-profit).
`Market` is rejected here — market orders execute immediately via `open_position`.

fields.name: price
docs: Limit price, PRICE_PRECISION (required for `Limit`/`TriggerLimit`; 0 for `TriggerMarket`).

fields.name: trigger_price
docs: Trigger price, PRICE_PRECISION (required for the trigger types; 0 otherwise).

fields.name: trigger_condition
docs: Fire when the oracle is `Above` / `Below` `trigger_price`.

fields.name: admin
docs: Admin authority (Squads multisig in production).

fields.name: collateral_mint
docs: The single collateral asset (development USDC for capstone/devnet evaluation).

fields.name: collateral_vault
docs: PDA token account holding all user collateral.

fields.name: insurance_fund_vault
docs: PDA token account backing the insurance fund.

fields.name: taker_fee_bps
docs: Fees, in basis points.

fields.name: max_oracle_staleness_seconds
docs: Oracle guard rails.

fields.name: paused
docs: Emergency pause — blocks all user-facing position changes when true.

fields.name: vault_authority_bump
docs: Bump for the shared vault authority PDA (signs vault transfers out).

fields.name: is_long
docs: Direction of the fill (true = long/buy base).

fields.name: is_close
docs: Whether this reduced/closed a position (vs opened/increased).

fields.name: price
docs: New price in PRICE_PRECISION (1e6).

fields.name: conf
docs: New confidence in PRICE_PRECISION (1e6).

fields.name: collateral
docs: Deposited collateral, QUOTE_PRECISION (USDC, 1e6).

fields.name: bad_debt
docs: Unrecovered bad debt (QUOTE_PRECISION) awaiting `resolve_perp_bankruptcy`.
